text: Westport Albion’s tactical shift at 18' is characterized by an increased frequency of direct, vertical passing that generated 7 final third entries in an 8-minute window, signaling a deliberate mechanism to penetrate Kingsmoor FC’s lines faster [#moment.facts.final_third_entries_in_window]. This approach exploits the spatial vulnerabilities inherent in Kingsmoor’s 4-4-2 wide, crossing-oriented setup, enabling Westport to assert control despite trailing by 2-0. Their possession of 46.1% combined with an 82.2% pass accuracy and a moderate PPDA of 10.5 indicates an effective transitional pressing trigger that maintains midfield dominance and facilitates quick vertical progressions after turnovers. The off-target shot by Rafael Delacroix (xG 0.144) at 14' exemplifies the initial exploitation of this tactical pivot, demonstrating the early success of their direct approach in creating meaningful shooting opportunities.
